title_sq: APARTAMENT 3+1+2 PER SHITJE PRANE MATERNITETIT TE RI!
description_sq:
Ofrohet për shitje nje apartament komod me siperfaqe totale prej 118 m2, i pozicionuar në katin e 3-te te nje pallati ekzistues.
Apartamenti organizohet ne:
3 dhoma gjumi
1 sallon + kuzhine
2 ballkone
2 tualete secila me dritare

Karakteristika:
Ndriçim natyral gjate gjithe dites
Planimetri e rregullt
Pallat ekzistues, mirembajtje e rregullt
Mundesi shume e mire investimi.
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni!
title_en: APARTMENT 3+1+2 FOR SALE NEAR THE NEW MATERNITY!
description_en: A comfortable apartment with a total area of ​​118 m2, located on the 3rd floor of an existing building, is offered for sale. The apartment is organized in: 3 bedrooms, 1 living room + kitchen, 2 balconies, 2 bathrooms, each with a window. The apartment is located in one of the most sought-after areas of Tirana, near the New Maternity Hospital, with immediate access to the main road, educational institutions, health and urban transport. Features: Natural lighting throughout the day Regular floor plan Existing building, regular maintenance Very good investment opportunity. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
